```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a countplot to visualize the survival rate by passenger class and gender
sns.countplot(data=df, x='pclass', hue='sex', palette='pastel')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Passenger Class Distribution by Gender on Titanic', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Gender')

# Save the plot as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
